description: List of synthesized or studied Epoxy materials extracted from the text.

polymer_name.description: Primary identifier used by the paper for the synthesized material.

polymer_type.description: Chemical class or stage (for example, Epoxy resin, Epoxy prepolymer, Cured epoxy network).

components.description: List of monomer-library strings corresponding to the resin-forming components.

ratio_type.description: How the reported ratio is expressed (for example, mole, weight, equivalent, phr, or unknown).

ratio_values_text.description: Overall formulation ratio text as written in the paper.

feed_ratio_text.description: Raw contextual wording that describes the feed or formulation ratio.

epoxy_resin_ratio.description: Ratio among epoxy resins WITH NAMES (e.g., "DGEBA:TGDDM = 80:20").

amine_hardener_ratio.description: Ratio among amine hardeners WITH NAMES (e.g., "DDS:DDM = 50:50").

anhydride_hardener_ratio.description: Ratio among anhydride hardeners WITH NAMES.

reactive_diluent_ratio.description: Ratio among reactive diluents or chain extenders WITH NAMES.

mn_value.description: Number-average molecular weight with unit if reported.

mw_value.description: Weight-average molecular weight with unit if reported.

pdi_value.description: Polydispersity index or dispersity value if reported.

test_method.description: Standardized method abbreviation such as GPC, SEC, Viscosity, NMR, or LS.
